name: Mitsurugi Sakuya
source:
A third-year student at Baramon High School. Blessed with the best soccer skills in the prefecture, Sakuya is the captain of the soccer club. However, in reality, he is a problem child who easily resorts to violence due to his physical abilities, on top of being a rascal. He guides and leads the junior protagonist with his strong personality.

"This is just the start of our secret club activities..."
